display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: The author writes the section in the authoring tools. [The section has content that the authoring tools can read.] (Author)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: A grading pass in the authoring tools gives the section its grade. [A score of 70 or more and 0 blocking defects.] (Author)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: The sponsor approves the version. [The change log records the approval.] (Sponsor)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: The author changes an approved section. [The section stays at review until the sponsor approves the new version.] (Author)
